sections.title: The 4 tabs
body: Home: today’s session, your shortcuts, your progress. Pick up here.
Fretboard: the neck in six layers (Notes, Intervals, Chords, Scales, CAGED, Triads). Tap a layer to switch.
Sunday: your songs, their chords, and sets if you prepare them.
Me: your settings, this guide, the list of tips.

sections.title: The little icons
body: ⓘ: “Understand”. Three levels: In short, On the neck, By ear, then “To remember”.
Light bulb: a tip, a memory trick to find a note or a shape.
Small “How it works” link: opens this guide at the right page, with a button to go back to where you were.

sections.title: Preparing a Sunday song
body: Go to Sunday and add a song, or enter its chords straight in Fretboard, Triads layer.
Pick the key, then the chords in the song’s order.
Tap “Suggest triads”: the app looks, inside your chosen zone, for the sequence where your hand moves the least.

sections.title: Entering a song’s chords
body: Open Fretboard, Triads layer, then “Chords”.
Type the chords separated by spaces: A F#m D E, or La Fa♯m Ré Mi. You can also paste a ChordPro chart.
Remove a chord by tapping its cross; add some from the palette of the key’s chords.
The capo is noted on the song, but triads are computed on the chords exactly as you typed them.

sections.title: Linking the church app
body: Linking to the church app is not active yet. The app works without it: enter your songs by hand.

sections.title: Choosing my triad zone
body: The zone is the frets where you want to keep your hand, for example 5 to 10.
With − and + you widen or narrow it. The narrower it is, the less your hand moves.
If a chord has no shape inside the zone, the app tells you: widen it.
“All inversions” shows a chord’s other shapes, in other zones too.

sections.title: Switching between acoustic and electric
body: At the top of Home, switch between acoustic and electric. On electric, no capo is suggested.

sections.title: Rearranging Home
body: Tap “Edit” on Home.
With the arrows, change the order of widgets; with the cross, remove one; “Add” brings one back.
The order is kept on your device. The “Next Sunday” widget only shows when there is a set.

sections.title: Playing with the metronome
body: The metronome comes later: it will go with the exercises and the triads.
